messages:
nina_sre: @here Planned egress-mesh failover drill + short smoke run tomorrow 05/02 22:00-23:00 UTC. Objective: swap to new NAT fleet and validate route convergence. Expect brief 5-20s hiccups for a small portion of flows.

sam_oncall: Which clusters/pools are touched and any opt-outs?

nina_sre: Affected: edge-gpu pools (gpu-pool-1, gpu-pool-3) and artifact egress paths. No customer opt-outs; well start with 3% traffic canary by region.

omar_net: Runbook link: https://go/internal/runbooks/egress-failover-1977. Canary plan: 3% -> 15% after 15m -> 100% after 45m soak if metrics stable. KV-cache warmup check is required pre-ramp.

tia_prod: Do we need to adjust SLOs or alert CS?

nina_sre: Temporary SLO corridor: p99 gen latency allowed up to 850ms for the 1h window. slo-bot will annotate. No status-page change unless customer-facing errors occur.

slo-bot: (automated) Annotation created: egress-failover-1977654322 window temp_p99=850ms.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: egress/mesh-swap-v1 -> canary @ 22:00 UTC, ramp per runbook. CI green.

sam_oncall: Ill be oncall. Pager rules: page for >1% 5m error spike or sustained p99 >950ms. I will trigger a 250-concurrent synthetic at T+10m to surface cold KV misses and will post logs here.

omar_net: Rollback command in runbook: `./egress_rollback.sh --run 1977654322`. Owners: omar_net + oncall.

nina_sre: Final: 24h and 30m reminders will be sent. DM if you need a particular internal job excluded (big backups, data-migration).

sam_oncall: Will monitor dashboards and post a short recap after window.

nina_sre: Drill completed; minor transient spikes observed during canary, all within expected window. Postmortem: will publish in #postmortems if any follow-ups required. :white_check_mark:
